stem: Given that the general term of the geometric sequence $\{a_n\}$ is $a_n = 7 \cdot (-1)^{n}$, which of the following statements is correct? ( )
solution: The terms are $-7, 7, -7, 7, \ldots$ ($S_n$ denotes the sum of the first $n$ terms). form: aₙ = c·(−1)ⁿ: which statement is correct (even partial sums are 0)
